_about: Option C baseline acceptance criteria. FEMP v5.0 values are used where FEMP states one; LBNL 2017 guidance fills the gaps. The project M&V plan governs and may set different targets (FEMP v5.0 Section 4.4 requires the plan to specify statistical validation targets).

sources.min_r2: FEMP M&V Guidelines v5.0 (September 2024), Section 5.3.4.1: IPMVP minimum acceptable R2 of 0.75
sources.max_abs_nmbe: FEMP M&V Guidelines v5.0, Section 5.3.4.1: ASHRAE Guideline 14 accepts net determination bias below 0.005 percent
sources.min_abs_slope_t: FEMP M&V Guidelines v5.0, Section 5.3.4.1: IPMVP specifies t-statistic greater than 2.0 for an independent variable
sources.max_cv_rmse: Not stated by FEMP v5.0 for Option C. LBNL (2017) guidance value citing ASHRAE Guideline 14. https://bies.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/acceptcriteria-doc-2017.pdf
sources.max_fsu: Not stated by FEMP v5.0. LBNL (2017) guidance value. https://bies.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/acceptcriteria-doc-2017.pdf
